outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E image and spatial transcriptomics heatmap overlays depicting mRNA distribution across tissue spots; it is not a summary plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a plot showing averaged quantitative data.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot in which each patient tumor sample (n=500 LUSC, n=512 LUAD) is plotted as an individual point, with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are shown.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each of the n=3 replicates overlaid on each bar.
